subject: general
question: What is the name of the large supercontinent that existed 200 million years ago when all the continents were together?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Pangea__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pangea **is the name of the large supercontinent that existed **200 million years **ago when all the continents were together.
 
• **Pangaea, **the supercontinent, emerged during the **late Paleozoic and early Mesozoic periods.**
 
• One notable segment of this ancient supercontinent was Gondwana Land, situated in the **southern part of Pangaea**, with Angara Land occupying the northern region.
 
• Initially, Gondwana was not classified as a supercontinent due to the separation of landmasses such as Baltica, Laurentia, and Siberia.
 
• Gondwana eventually emerged as the largest continental landmass during the** Paleozoic Era**, spanning approximately 100,000,000 square kilometers, or about one-fifth of Earth's surface.
 
• Areas once part of Gondwana continue to exhibit shared botanical and zoological characteristics that endure to the present day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **A supercontinent** is a vast landmass comprising most or all of **Earth's continents**.
 
• Some geologists characterize a supercontinent as an amalgamation of once-disparate continents.
 
• These supercontinents have cyclically formed and fragmented over the course of Earth's history.
 
• The most recent supercontinent, Pangea, coalesced between 450 and 320 million years ago.
 
• Its fragmentation commenced approximately 185 million years ago and continues to disperse to this day.
